evidence: jonathanlydall says they are very happy with their Sealion 5, while reporting two minor software issues involving a parking indicator and wireless CarPlay.

evidence_sources.author: jonathanlydall
evidence_sources.excerpt: I’ve been super happy with my Sealion 5 (PHEV) I bought in May, tank is still over half full since last filling it up mid July and having done about 4,500km since. I have had two minor software issues. One time the one parking sensor warning indicator kind of got stuck on the centre screen (no noise though). The other was my wireless CarPlay refusing to connect.

source_story_title: I went to Mexico to test-drive the cars Americans can’t buy
